evidence.proved: EPYC-01 is EUR 3.99 a month with 1 vCore, 4 GB RAM and 50 GB storage
no traffic limit is published, with a fair-use throttle reserved for disproportionately high sustained usage
evidence.quote: No, there is no traffic limit for our servers. The uplink is provided according to the fair use principle. However, bandwidth may be temporarily throttled in the event of disproportionately high sustained usage.

evidence.proved: the terms reserve a temporary throttle for excessive use, level and limit at the provider's discretion
evidence.quote: In case of excessive use of the data traffic included in the tariff, the connection will be temporarily throttled.

evidence.proved: account creation needs an email address and a password
evidence.quote: A valid email address and a secure password must be provided for account creation.

evidence.proved: the EPYC-01 offer table lists 300 Mbit/s as the port speed with unmetered traffic
the provider states the port speed is the only limit and there is no volume allowance
evidence.quote: Traffic is unmetered: the listed port speed is a hard rate limit applied at the hypervisor NIC, so there is no monthly volume allowance, no overage billing and no post-quota throttle.

evidence.proved: full root access on KVM, a dedicated IPv4 and a routed /64 on every plan
evidence.quote: All plans are KVM on Proxmox VE with full root access, one dedicated IPv4 address and a routed IPv6 /64 per server.

evidence.proved: no identity document, phone number or verification call is stated
evidence.quote: No KYC. No ID document, no phone number, no verification call.

evidence.proved: the EUR 3.99 entry plan cannot be paid in cryptocurrency
evidence.quote: Cryptocurrency orders have a €5.00 minimum, so their €3.99 entry plan is card/PayPal only.

evidence.proved: orders are completed only for billing addresses in the EU-27
evidence.quote: Their checkout and invoicing are wired for EU VAT only, so a US, UK, Swiss or Canadian buyer cannot complete an order today.
